Hymn 287: Rise, Ye Saints, and Temples Enter
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Frank W. Asper
Lyricist/Text Author: Ralph W. Elison
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 287 titled "Rise, Ye Saints, and Temples Enter" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Frank W. Asper and the lyrics were written by Ralph W. Elison.
